entries.5084b59991f72d0c: In April 2023, the company's group formulated the long-term vision 'Vision 2030 NEXT Kanagawa Chuo Kotsu: Toward a Regional Value-Creating Company,' with fiscal 2030 as its final year. The long-term vision sets three policies: 'creating regional value,' 'restructuring the business portfolio,' and 'promoting sustainability management.' The Kanagawa Chuo Kotsu Group Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026), formulated in April 2024, positions the period as the first stage of the 'Leap Phase' toward realizing the long-term vision, and it is working on three priority issues, 'realizing sustainable mobility services,' 'strengthening real estate-related fields' and 'contributing to a rich way of living,' and three priority strategies, 'environmental strategy,' 'human capital strategy' and 'digital strategy.'
